name: Superstreamer - API
description: Superstreamer is here to make video delivery simple. Imagine having everything you need in one platform — starting with your raw video, Superstreamer helps you transcode it, package it into HLS playlists, and upload it to S3 with ease. You can even create custom playlists for each viewer, adding bumpers, ads, or filters on the fly.
requires:
This is the API for the Superstreamer suite. It requires other Superstreamer containers to be running. 
        [br]
        This container requires a separate Redis database.

ports.name: Application Port
ports.description: Port over which other containers will communicate with this container

variables.name: AWS S3 - Endpoint
variables.description: URL for S3 storage bucket (minus bucket name) used to store media files.

variables.name: AWS S3 - Bucket
variables.description: Name of the S3 storage bucket used to store media files.

variables.name: AWS S3 - Region
variables.description: Region of the S3 storage bucket used to store media files.

variables.name: AWS S3 - Access Key
variables.description: Access key for the S3 storage bucket used to store media files.

variables.name: AWS S3 - Secret Key
variables.description: Secret key for the S3 storage bucket used to store media files.

variables.name: Internal App Port
variables.description: Internal port for container. Not recommended to change.
